finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the number of bytes received exceeds 1024, it will overflow the buffer.
finding.assumptions: The buffer size is fixed at 1024 bytes, and the recv function does not perform bounds checking.

parsed.change_summary: Reduced the buffer size by 1 byte in the recv function call to prevent buffer overflow.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: By reducing the buffer size by 1 byte, the maximum number of bytes that can be received is now 1023. This ensures that even if the number of bytes received equals the buffer size, there will be space for the null terminator, preventing buffer overflow.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked that recv() will not write more bytes than the length argument; the length passed is sizeof(buffer) which is 1024, matching the buffer size. Therefore no overflow can occur. No other checks or code paths could cause a larger write.
